Thanks for the packet — received and uploaded to our onboarding tracker. Looping in Kimberly from AP and Marissa on vendor master owners to finalize a couple items so we can create the vendor profile in NetSuite and set PO channels.

Two quick clarifications before we kick off:
1) Legal entity name on the Certificate of Incorporation reads "Bluecove Diagnostics, Inc." — is that the entity that will invoice Redwood, or will invoices come from a related entity (e.g., a parent or regional subsidiary)? If either, please confirm the exact remittance legal name.
2) For ACH: do you have a dedicated remit/ACH contact and bank name we should capture on the vendor record? If you prefer not to share bank details via email, we can accept a secure DocuSign / portal upload.

Marissa/Kimberly — if those fields are clean we should be able to create the vendor master today. Also note: we generally set 'PO required' = Yes for new suppliers in this category; flag here if you want invoicing-only.

Sam — once legal name and remit confirmation are back I will trigger vendor creation and share the VM ID and PO instructions (format + required fields).
